items.title: Archie Martin Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: Ace Watson. That was the first one I'd named. That was the best Marshall ever had.

ctx.x: Well what about the Elks? Are you an Elk? Yeah. And you take care of the place now? Takes care of it now yeah. Tell me who do you think were some of the good grand marshals that the Elks had?
Ace Watson. That was the first one I'd named. That was the best Marshall ever had.
You ever see his picture on that record they have out? Yeah. You know that Eureka has a record out of Blue Collar and he's Ace's only.
